entities.name: Aiman
entities.description: A Fallaji soldier and veteran in the Brothers' War who lost an eye at the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: The burning of the city of Kroog in 28 AR.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: City consumed by flames in the battle.

entities.name: Laria
entities.description: Argivian soldier who left a gift of chocolate and a note.

entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Campaign in 44 AR for which Aiman was recalled.

events.summary: Aiman was severely injured at the Fall of Kroog and lost an eye.
events.quote: Aiman was severely injured in the aftermath of the Fall of Kroog

events.summary: Aiman was recalled to active duty for the Tomakul Campaign to train new warriors.
events.quote: Aiman was recalled to active duty for the Tomakul Campaign in 44 AR, this time to train new warriors

events.summary: Aiman and his comrades kept secret intelligence that clay statues and transmogrants could fight the battle to avoid being branded traitors.
events.quote: They decided to keep this information secret to avoid being branded as traitors.

events.summary: The Fallaji soldiers found the Argivian trench abandoned, and Farid found Laria's gift.
events.quote: they found it abandoned, its soldiers having fled the front

relations.quote: Aiman's old wounds did not deter him as he fought alongside Farid and the others.
